finalText:
All 12 files syntax-checked clean, no `FAIL` lines.

Migration's done. All 33 `db.query` calls across the 12 remaining package files (billing, support, catalog, analytics, orders, accounts) are now `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used elsewhere. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, but that's a vendored third-party copy marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on upgrade," so I left it alone. Every changed file passed `node --check`.
